# BNBTiger / COOKIE getter proof fixtures

Complete original captures and official-compiler outputs for the host-only
[getter proof](../../../docs/bnbtiger-cookie-getter-proof.md). All source bytes,
paths, metadata, layout and maps remain intact. The captures include the original
source notices; upstream dependency LICENSE files are preserved separately.

BNBTiger has one flattened source with unestablished primary origin. COOKIE has
eight exact immutable dependency matches and three custom-source origin gaps.
No source normalization, candidate configuration or production permission is
introduced. Getter controls use synthetic storage and zero call value only.
